title: P16-C CEO consumes ReasoningBrief — advisory projection bound inside observation_digest
description: P16-C: CEO observation carries the advisory ReasoningBrief — canonical observation stays the ONLY authority. ceo-planning-cycle.ts: CeoObservationDeps.brain_brief? seam; buildCeoObservation attaches the projection under observation.brain_brief INSIDE observation_digest so cycle identity/replay/post-invocation drift all bind brief content; read identity is the strict-verified owner_authority_id (invoker actor stays on attempt provenance, C6); seam IntegrityErrors degrade to a deterministic BRAIN_BRIEF_UNAVAILABLE marker (error code only) inside the digest — the seam's stronger KPI/budget re-proof can never wedge the cycle or replay on legitimately-degraded objectives like lapsed verifier grants (C4a/C12); non-IntegrityError propagates fail-closed pre-claim (C4b); owner_authority_id re-validated via assertOwnerAuthorityRef. reasoning-brief.ts: briefObservationView shares the ONE digest projection — exactly brief_digest-pinned fields + brief_digest; volatile fields cannot leak; digest(view − brief_digest) === brief_digest (C7). ceo-decision.ts: prompt names advisory boundary — options name authority channels, never commands (C1/C10). ceo-runtime.ts: injectable + default wiring. Reads only — identical event/entity footprint (C5); unchanged validator rejects malformed output (C3); bound-objective facts through PRIORITIZE (C11); mid-flight policy mutation settles STALE only when wired (C9). Replay: zero extra calls (C2). CONTRACT SHIFT: p15-5 test 18 — mid-flight allocation now stales at the earlier cycle boundary (FAIL_CLOSED_CEO_OBSERVATION_STALE vs FAIL_CLOSED_P15_5_STALE_REVIEW); zero-commit invariant unchanged. No retries/fallback/second authority; Codex-only.
